title: poa trivialis var. sylvicola
intro: Poa trivialis var. sylvicola, commonly known as woodland meadow-grass, is a variety of the Poa trivialis plant, a perennial grass native to Europe. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, and is believed to help with digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Poa trivialis var. sylvicola include acting as a demulcent and expectorant, soothing irritated tissues and promoting the removal of excess mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
